title: Read-only Alex worker failure and active Cloud Run audit
instruction:
Darius requests investigation of active Cloud Run task and ticket failures. Reported UI error: Proactive solution plan - ALEX (failed): tickets_agent command center job failed: RuntimeError: Codex worker exited with code 1. Codex could not complete this run (exit 1) before producing a response. The runtime discarded the failed session so the next attempt can start cleanly. This task is infrastructure diagnosis ONLY, not ticket work. Use existing authorized read capabilities only; do not change services, IAM, auth, source, queues, customer records or tickets, and do not retry any mutating job. Do not switch reasoning providers or re-enable retired lanes.

1. Read LIVE Cloud Run state in gen-lang-client-0051653266 / us-central1 for the actual Command Center and relay services. Return source SHA, serving revision, traffic and deployed image digest when available. Clearly separate live evidence from repository assumptions.
2. Locate the most recent matching tickets_agent proactive-plan failure and its worker exit evidence. Return sanitized job correlation ID, event timestamps, attempt number, provider and model, Codex version, normalized error class, exit code, duration and a minimal redacted diagnostic summary. Keep raw stderr, prompts, task text and customer evidence PRIVATE. Check auth-readiness metadata without reading or returning auth.json or credentials, stale/resumed-session handling, unsupported CLI/config/model errors, timeout/OOM/revision interruption and concurrent worker limits. Say which are proven vs untested.
3. Inspect how proactive investigation/solution-plan jobs become executed ticket work, what tools and authority Alex actually receives, failure/retry state and whether completion requires durable action evidence. Identify source functions/paths and the smallest repair with regression tests; do not implement or deploy during this read-only task.
4. Return counts only for recent completed/failed/queued/running jobs by lane and type if the existing read path supports it. No ticket content or customer identifiers.

PRIVACY: Results are committed to GitHub. Return SANITIZED INFRASTRUCTURE METADATA ONLY. Never output secret values, env values, tokens, auth contents, private file bodies, raw logs, Salesforce ticket bodies, names, emails, addresses, billing records, SQL rows or customer screenshots. Use a private result handle for any sensitive evidence, not the evidence itself. Do not claim a live check, action or successful verification without actual tool readback. If a read capability is unavailable, state the exact blocker and stop that check rather than rediscovering tools broadly.
